real_name: Sajid Mir (real name kept in film)
real_life_notes: Real LeT handler and primary planner of the 26/11 attacks. His voice was identified by FBI on recordings communicating with the 10 attackers during the attacks. Was 'declared dead' by Pakistani authorities in 2022 in a transparent attempt to avoid FATF (Financial Action Task Force) blacklisting — then quietly 'resurrected' and sentenced in May 2023 to 15 years on terror financing charges after US pressure. His documented role as a 26/11 handler is unambiguous.
film_role: Film 2 target — Sajid Mir's voice on real attack recordings is depicted in the film as irrefutable evidence. His elimination is part of the revenge arc.
objective: Avoid accountability; continue operational planning under ISI cover; leverage Pakistan's legal ambiguity as protection
real_status: Sentenced May 2023, 15 years, by a Pakistani anti-terrorism court — under US pressure and FATF threat. Widely seen as cosmetic accountability.
fatf_context: Pakistan was grey-listed by FATF from 2018–2022 partly due to failure to prosecute 26/11 planners. Mir's 'resurrection' and prosecution was a direct FATF compliance move.
